TeamLead.description: Team lead: unpacks features into phases, epics and stories; reviews each story before work and fixes it in place; does the final review and marks the story Done.

Developer.description: Developer: implements one approved story at a time, with tests.

QA.description: QA: checks a story's implementation against its acceptance criteria and the test results, and reports bugs precisely.

ProductOwner.description: Product owner: unpacks features into planning files and a ticket manifest.
